topic: Updating frequency formula for multiple cities
summary_markdown:
Someone identified an error in the existing frequency calculation formula, realizing it was applicable not only to Libreville but also to Abidjan. A Pull Request (PR) was submitted to update the `frequency_v2` function by adding a `city` parameter and supporting both Libreville and Abidjan within the formula.

[me] confirmed receipt of the PR and agreed to implement the changes on beta.
decisions: The frequency calculation formula will be updated to support multiple cities (Libreville and Abidjan).
action_items: Update the new frequency logic via the submitted Pull Request on the beta environment.
